notes_for_editor: Thin record. Firelookout.ca gives the steel tower, the Algonquin Park location, elevation and the 1963 map listing, but no build year, height, staffing, access or photos. The Ominous page carries no date and does not mention McLaughlin; its line that only the Big Crow Lake tower remains does not settle this site's fate. The brief's record matches Firelookout.ca, so no corrections. The name's origin is not in any source. Two web searches and about four page reads were used.
